Visit our channel for surgery rehabilitation videos, patient testimonials and detailed shoulder condition and treatment information from Cleveland Shoulder Institute's Founder, Dr. Reuben Gobezie. In 2026, Dr. Gobezie will also be adding new content around general healthcare education. 

Dr. Gobezie is an internationally recognized Orthopedic Surgeon and leader in the care of shoulder and sports injuries. A graduate of Harvard Medical School, he was named one of the top 25 shoulder specialists in the US as ranked by leaders in the field. Dr. Gobezie is a six-time Patient’s Choice award winner, an honor bestowed on less than one percent of physicians nationally. He has also been recognized on the Top Doctors list nationally by Castle Connolly and locally as one of Cleveland Magazine’s best doctors. Call us at 844-746-8537 (844-SHOULDR) to schedule a consultation.
